The '''Kynachi''' were the native [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kynachi]] in the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The Kynachi were generally distinguished by their golden hair. Their golden hair was partially a result from their native diet, so those who were not raised on the planet of Kynachi did not share this particular trait. One example was the silver-haired, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]-raised [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ring-Sol Ambase]].

During the year [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] seized the world of the Kynachi under the force of the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Umbrag]]. In the year [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Kynachi were liberated from the Trade Federation occupation by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Breakout Squad]] unit led by [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Nuru Kungurama]].
